proofUses.reason: Independent intensity layers establish monotonicity; the threshold implications follow from the infimum definitions.
Harris and a positive finite support path transfer survival; countable unions identify global positivity.
Equality of scaled profiles and order-preserving reparametrisation identify the percolating-parameter infima.
Loop erasure and ordered product coupling compare graph observables; inclusion of parameter sets reverses the threshold ordering.
The finite product of positive-support opening probabilities tends to one and squeezes the two-point measure.
